mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friendship (user_id1, user_id2, create_time) VALUES (#{userId1}, #{userId2}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, CASE WHEN f.user_id1 = #{uid} THEN f.user_id2 ELSE f.user_id1 END AS friend_uid, u.nickname AS friend_nickname, u.avatar AS friend_avatar FROM friendship f LEFT JOIN user u ON u.uid = CASE WHEN f.user_id1 = #{uid} THEN f.user_id2 ELSE f.user_id1 END WHERE f.user_id1 = #{uid} OR f.user_id2 = #{uid} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM friendship WHERE (user_id1 = #{uid1} AND user_id2 = #{uid2}) OR (user_id1 = #{uid2} AND user_id2 = #{uid1}) LIMIT 1
